speaker: john_heminges
text: Entrances, not speeches. We are on at two, and I am not rehearsing a play we already know by heart.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then give me my door and let me be. I am not adding a line at nine in the morning.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Your door is the door it was. I have nothing new to put in your mouth.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Good. Item, the doors. Item, two o'clock. Item, no new matter before dinner.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I can live on an item. You, Will. Do not look like a man with a secret at a rehearsal.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am looking like a man who has to be home before noon. That is the whole of the look.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then be home before noon. We will still be on at two if you are.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Be on at two with the rest of us. I am not carrying your entrance for you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will be on. God give you the morning.
